span.label: the two-step bacterial conversion the whole system rests on: nitroso-bacteria take ammonia to nitrite, nitro-bacteria take nitrite to nitrate, and the nitrate is both far less toxic to the fish and the plants' main nitrogen source
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: two opposing forces act on system pH and one of them wins: nitrate uptake by roots RAISES pH by releasing bicarbonate, nitrification LOWERS it by producing acid, and the acid side has the larger effect, so the system drifts down continuously
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the proposed fix for the drift - dissolved limestone releases hydroxide as it solubilizes, raising pH continuously at a rate set by the flow rate rather than in steps like a dosed buffer
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: why the nutrients may be present and unmeasured: in aquaponic water the dissolved solids include organic molecules, and the standard measurements register only the ionic fraction
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: between 30% and 65% of the phosphorus entering as fish feed leaves as solid excretion and is filtered out, and what does dissolve can precipitate with calcium - which is why aquaponic phosphate sits far below the hydroponic recommendation
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the constraint that makes pest management hard: the system's function depends on a living nitrifying biofilm, so pesticides, antibiotics and fungicides are ruled out not by regulation but because they would kill the machinery
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the one integrated comparison it does find has nothing to be compared against

span.label: supply chain → environmental impact
span.note: LENGTH OF A CHAIN AS A COST MULTIPLIER. The longer the supply chain the more transport, packaging, conservation and labour it needs, up to 79% of retail price in US conventional distribution. `causes` is right and the ENDPOINT is not a concept in this record - what lengthens is a chain and what grows is a bundle of costs and impacts, and there is no node for the bundle
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: pesticides → biofilm
span.note: A PROHIBITION, NOT A MEASURED EFFECT. Conventional pesticides cannot be used in aquaponics because they would poison the fish and the nitrifying biofilm the system depends on. `causes ... reduces` overstates it - nobody applied them and measured a reduction; the relation is that one RULES OUT the other, and the vocabulary has no type for a constraint
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: electrical conductivity → organic molecules
span.note: THE MEASUREMENT THAT MISSES ITS OBJECT. Electrical conductivity and aqueous filtration register only nutrients in ionic form, so nutrients locked inside organic molecules are present and unrecorded. This is the exact negation CLAUDE_B's quine1951 row names: all eight edge types assert a relation HOLDS, and `X is the measurement that FAILS to see Y` cannot be written. `operationalised-as` would state the opposite of the truth
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: sustainable agriculture - NOT DEFINED BY THIS PAPER. It is taken whole from Lehman et al., as a process that depletes no non-renewable resource essential to agriculture, and extended with Francis et al.'s `designing systems that close nutrient cycles`. Aquaponics then qualifies BY CONSTRUCTION, because closing a nutrient cycle is what it is. The definition is borrowed and the conclusion follows from the borrowing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: nutrient concentration, when an aquaponic solution is compared with a hydroponic one - A MEASUREMENT, NOT A QUANTITY OF NUTRIENT. Electrical conductivity and aqueous filtration see only ions, and aquaponic dissolved solids include organic molecules with nutrients locked inside them. So the aquaponic column reads lower partly because the instrument cannot see what is there - and the authors print the comparison and this objection to it on the same page
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: challenge, the paper's own organising word - IT COVERS TWO DIFFERENT THINGS AND THE review does not separate them. Some challenges are engineering problems with candidate solutions (pH drift, and a lime-bed reactor to fix it). Others are ABSENCES IN THE LITERATURE - two economic studies, no comparison available, parameters unreported. A reader counting `challenges` counts both kinds together
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: decoupled system - THE NAME FOR GIVING UP ON THE COMPROMISE. Fish, plants and nitrifying bacteria have different optimal pH and temperature, and a single loop must sit between them; a decoupled system runs two loops at their own optima and exchanges water periodically. It is presented as an alternative to the trade-off, not as an improvement to it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: zero-discharge recirculating system - AN OBJECTIVE, NOT A DESCRIPTION. The paper says it `should be achievable` on Neori et al.'s authority and immediately says more research is needed on the solubilization it depends on. Nothing in the review reports one running
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: critiques → Vermeulen and Kamstra, who found only a marginal cost reduction from aquaponics against RAS and hydroponics run separately
span.note: the objection is specific and it is about SCOPE, not arithmetic: the costing left out resource scarcity, and rising energy and fertilizer prices are expected to move the margin. The review does not claim the calculation was wrong
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: retracted: RE-GROUNDED - CLAUDE_B'S PROVEN CASE, 2026-08-23 22:44. The old evidence was `A crucial point in aquaponic systems is the pH stabilization ... The optimal pH for each living component is different.` - verbatim, anchored, correctly cut, and containing NOT ONE of the claim's numbers. The sentence stating the claim is two paragraphs away and is now the evidence. The claim's trailing clause `one of the inputs to the 6.8-7.0 compromise` refers to a separate sentence and is a CROSS-REFERENCE, not part of what this quote is asked to support.
